\"E_80001_Clip01_002\".m_mContent: "—In this very moment, a new Other Side takes form within my grasp."

\"E_80001_Clip01_003\".m_mContent: "All life and history, faith and science, shall be reborn within this radiant new… world in a bottle of my design. It requires a name... Yes 'The Exodus'—a vessel for genesis, nurtured by my will."

\"E_80001_Clip01_004\".m_mContent: "I see threads spun from time itself, drawing this Other Side into the present I occupy."

\"E_80001_Clip01_005\".m_mContent: "I hear wheels turned by blood, driving this Other Side toward the future I have envisioned."

\"E_80001_Clip01_006\".m_mContent: "Life and death shall unfold as I decree. The very cogs of reality shall obey my direction."

\"E_80001_Clip01_007\".m_mContent: "Just as Aeon breathed life into the world that bore me, so too shall I ascend to become the god of The Exodus."

\"E_80001_Clip01_008\".m_mContent: "I shall savor the exquisite privilege of observation… Awaiting the inevitable day when The Exodus births another iteration of myself—who, in turn, shall craft his own Other Side. …Wait."

\"E_80001_Clip01_009\".m_mContent: "Only now do I grasp this possibility—fascinating... and deeply disquieting."

\"E_80001_Clip01_010\".m_mContent: "If I can forge an Other Side that contains another 'me'... And if that version, in all certainty, will repeat this process anew…"

\"E_80001_Clip01_011\".m_mContent: "Then what of the world I now inhabit? Could it be that it was not shaped by divine hands at all? But by yet another version of myself? So this is the pattern…"

\"E_80001_Clip01_014\".m_mContent: "I remember saying farewell to Noah and the others... at the blessed grounds on Sunset Isle just moments ago..."

\"E_80001_Clip01_015\".m_mContent: "I should've faded completely into longing by now..."

\"E_80001_Clip01_016\".m_mContent: "Is this the realm of the dead? It's far livelier than I ever imagined."

\"E_80001_Clip01_018\".m_mContent: "So lively, with cries for help and every— Wait, someone's actually in trouble!?!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_020\".m_mContent: "It really is her! With her here, we don't have to worry about being eaten by those spiders!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_022\".m_mContent: "Those things don't look anything like spiders… In fact, even calling them 'monsters' feels generous..."

\"E_80001_Clip01_024\".m_mContent: "As expected of Vice-Commander to Lord Albrecht, Bell Ringer No. III!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_025\".m_mContent: "Albrecht? There's no way I'd serve as that arrogant cur's vice-commander!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_026\".m_mContent: "…You must be talking about my granddaughter."

\"E_80001_Clip01_027\".m_mContent: "You can't be serious! You look so young—how could you possibly have a granddaughter?!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_028\".m_mContent: "That's because our family is... rather special."

\"E_80001_Clip01_029\".m_mContent: "And you're so beautiful! So brave, so strong!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_030\".m_mContent: "That's enough. I am your Vice-Commander—Piera Paracelsus."

\"E_80001_Clip01_031\".m_mContent: "Then please, Vice-Commander Piera—report this directly to Lord Albrecht!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_032\".m_mContent: "What? Albrecht's here too? Don't tell me… he's dead as well?"

\"E_80001_Clip01_033\".m_mContent: "It's all because of those spiders—they came out of nowhere and—What did you say? Lord Albrecht is dead?!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_034\".m_mContent: "Please don't jest about such things! Lord Albrecht is an invincible, exalted Bell Ringer—he could never die!"

\"E_80001_Clip01_035\".m_mContent: "They're quite right, you know... It's been far too long, Vice-Commander Piera."

\"E_80001_Clip01_036\".m_mContent: "Or perhaps I should use your true name—Madam Regina?"

\"E_80001_Clip02_001\".m_mContent: "I never thought I'd find you here of all places."

\"E_80001_Clip02_003\".m_mContent: "To encounter you here—what an extraordinary honor!"

\"E_80001_Clip02_007\".m_mContent: "We're here to guard you, my lord!"

\"E_80001_Clip02_008\".m_mContent: "I meant I would prefer no other ears."

\"E_80001_Clip02_009\".m_mContent: "Ah—of course! With us on guard, not a soul will overhear!"

\"E_80001_Clip02_010\".m_mContent: "He wants you two to leave. We need to speak… alone."

\"E_80001_Clip02_013\".m_mContent: "Well, we're alone now. What did you want to say, you alchemy-addled fool?"

\"E_80001_Clip02_014\".m_mContent: "Don't tell me you used one of your bizarre methods to bring me back."

\"E_80001_Clip02_015\".m_mContent: "That is precisely what I intend to find out."

\"E_80001_Clip02_016\".m_mContent: "In my memory, you did die. And yet, I was not the one who returned you to this world."

\"E_80001_Clip02_019\".m_mContent: "Perhaps we ought to ask these curious spiders who arrived with you."

\"E_80001_Clip02_020\".m_mContent: "It seems they carry the secret of your resurrection."

\"E_80001_Clip02_021\".m_mContent: "What? What do they have to do with where I came from? And why are you tearing them apart?"

\"E_80001_Clip02_022\".m_mContent: "These vials contain the energy that animates them—"

\"E_80001_Clip02_023\".m_mContent: "A new expression of 'water' that has eluded even my understanding."

\"E_80001_Clip02_024\".m_mContent: "I see... But what does that have to do with what we were just talking about?"

\"E_80001_Clip02_025\".m_mContent: "Everything. There is no form of 'water' in this world I do not comprehend. Therefore..."

\"E_80001_Clip02_026\".m_mContent: "Therefore what? How does this explain where I came from?"

\"E_80001_Clip02_027\".m_mContent: "You… and those creatures… You must have originated from the Other Side. A world beyond our current knowledge."

\"E_80001_Clip03_001\".m_mContent: "Tell me... when do you think a person truly dies?"

\"E_80001_Clip03_003\".m_mContent: "Perhaps when they are forgotten by the world."

\"E_80001_Clip03_006\".m_mContent: "Oh? Then are you the type to define a person by their existence?"

\"E_80001_Clip03_008\".m_mContent: "This is your ninth question. What final trial awaits me?"

\"E_80001_Clip03_009\".m_mContent: "For someone like you? It should be the simplest part—"

\"E_80001_Clip03_012\".m_mContent: "These creatures… slathered in some viscous compound. Is this your grand culmination? Utterly grotesque."

\"E_80001_Clip03_013\".m_mContent: "Aside from your failure to appreciate the sublime beauty of my designs… You are acceptable."

\"E_80001_Clip03_014\".m_mContent: "You shall serve as envoy of this crumbling world. Sent to explore the higher-dimensional realm that watches us from beyond."

\"E_80001_Clip03_015\".m_mContent: "The future of our search for sanctuary now rests with you… Our 'star.'"

\"E_80001_Clip03_017\".m_mContent: "Take my constructs with you. When the moment of truth arrives, they will be… useful."

\"E_80001_Clip03_019\".m_mContent: "You misunderstand me. I seek hope. Not to bring ruin to another world, as we once did our own."

\"E_80001_Clip03_020\".m_mContent: "Then tread carefully. We cannot know what enemies await you in that place."

\"E_80001_Clip03_021\".m_mContent: "I doubt I'll find anyone over there as difficult as you."

\"E_80001_Clip03_022\".m_mContent: "That is precisely what troubles me. The possibility that somewhere in that realm... another version of me may already be observing."

\"E_80001_Clip03_024\".m_mContent: "Just in case… follow her. Quietly. And whatever you do—don't let yourselves be seen."

\"E_80001_Clip04_004\".m_mContent: "Noah! Are you even listening to me?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_005\".m_mContent: "Oi, noisy bat—what are you standing around for?! If we don’t move, we’ll miss the opening of the harvest festival!"

\"E_80001_Clip04_006\".m_mContent: "We finally won at Starfall Valley's sealed area and broke the curse. For the first time in centuries, the Bloodborn may walk beneath the sun."

\"E_80001_Clip04_007\".m_mContent: "…Perhaps this is the first time in ages Lady Empousa has ever danced in daylight, among so many joyful souls."

\"E_80001_Clip04_008\".m_mContent: "It's just daylight! You're acting like stepping outside is some grand miracle, you mangy bat."

\"E_80001_Clip04_009\".m_mContent: "Says the stupid wolf who sobs over her wilted little flower like it's the end of the world."

\"E_80001_Clip04_012\".m_mContent: "What are you mumbling about? Didn't we agree to come here together?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_013\".m_mContent: "This is the Garden of Asta. One of the grandest cities on the Northern Continent."

\"E_80001_Clip04_014\".m_mContent: "We arrived just in time for the Harvest Festival. Lady Empousa wouldn't dream of missing such a celebration—not now when the sun no longer burns her."

\"E_80001_Clip04_015\".m_mContent: "Asta is also one of the few places where alchemy is freely studied. In fact… it is the birthplace of modern alchemy itself."

\"E_80001_Clip04_016\".m_mContent: "Hold on a second—did I just hear someone mention alchemy?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_017\".m_mContent: "Hmm? Me? Are you speaking to me?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_019\".m_mContent: "Hahaha! Look at me—I'm clearly a merchant!"

\"E_80001_Clip04_020\".m_mContent: "With the Harvest Festival in full swing, traders from across the continent are hawking their rarest wares!"

\"E_80001_Clip04_021\".m_mContent: "If anything catches your eye, feel free to take your pick..."

\"E_80001_Clip04_022\".m_mContent: "This one looks nice. I'll take it."

\"E_80001_Clip04_024\".m_mContent: "What? Didn't you just say I could pick...?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_025\".m_mContent: "Apologies. Our lady hasn't spent much time outside the manor. She's… unfamiliar with how this works."

\"E_80001_Clip04_026\".m_mContent: "Hard to believe folks dressed so plainly could be nobility… I might just make a killing today."

\"E_80001_Clip04_027\".m_mContent: "Oi—I heard every word of that little plan of yours."

\"E_80001_Clip04_028\".m_mContent: "I'd like to see this one. What's your asking price?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_029\".m_mContent: "Let's see here… huh? When did I even stock something like this?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_034\".m_mContent: "Hey! You can't just put dangerous things up for sale like that!"

\"E_80001_Clip04_035\".m_mContent: "I told you already—this isn't even my merchandise!"

\"E_80001_Clip04_036\".m_mContent: "Look what you've done to my stall... (sniff)... Can't you at least buy something to make up for the mess?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_037\".m_mContent: "Could that strange fluid beneath the metal shell be its power source?"

\"E_80001_Clip04_038\".m_mContent: "It resembles the work of an alchemist, though… with current methods, animating a metal construct through liquid propulsion should be impossible."

\"E_80001_Clip04_040\".m_mContent: "I believe his expertise lies more in biological research."

\"E_80001_Clip04_041\".m_mContent: "Didn't you say this place was the birthplace of alchemy, Aiona? Maybe some ancient alchemist built it."

\"E_80001_Clip04_042\".m_mContent: "We need to get to the celebration grounds. Once the crowd swells, we won’t be able to push through."

\"E_80001_Clip04_043\".m_mContent: "Come now, surely you'll buy something? I'll give you twenty percent off!"

\"E_80001_Clip05_001\".m_mContent: "Ugh, looks like the whole city's moving in the same direction... We're never getting through this."

\"E_80001_Clip05_002\".m_mContent: "The Harvest Celebration is about to begin. Even more people will be converging on the center of Asta."

\"E_80001_Clip05_003\".m_mContent: "If there weren't so many people around, I'd transform and just fly over this whole mess."

\"E_80001_Clip05_004\".m_mContent: "Let's all move together. Don't get separated in the crowd."

\"E_80001_Clip05_005\".m_mContent: "Noah? What is it? You just stopped."

\"E_80001_Clip05_006\".m_mContent: "Someone brushed past me just now... and whispered..."

\"E_80001_Clip05_007\".m_mContent: "Stop dawdling! If we don't hurry, we'll miss the whole thing!"

\"E_80001_Clip05_010\".m_mContent: "Forgive me… But if I heard correctly, just now… You were speaking to me?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_013\".m_mContent: "An explosion—there's been an explosion! Over by the plaza!"

\"E_80001_Clip05_014\".m_mContent: "Those constructs we saw at the vendor stalls... Are these the same ones? Did they cause the blast?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_015\".m_mContent: "...So the time flow truly differs between our sides. They've already evolved this far?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_016\".m_mContent: "You know what they are, don't you?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_018\".m_mContent: "And what are you supposed to be? Let go—I need to stop them."

\"E_80001_Clip05_019\".m_mContent: "Can we talk now? Those constructs weren't ordinary—"

\"E_80001_Clip05_020\".m_mContent: "—especially those bottles strapped to their backs. Is that what's powering them?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_021\".m_mContent: "You didn't even know what they were… and still went at them full force? What if you set off another explosion?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_022\".m_mContent: "Full force? I was just following your lead."

\"E_80001_Clip05_024\".m_mContent: "Stop getting in my way. Leave with your companions—now."

\"E_80001_Clip05_025\".m_mContent: "So this is what you meant by 'leave with them'?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_026\".m_mContent: "Are these constructs going to bring danger to Asta?"

\"E_80001_Clip05_027\".m_mContent: "Why tell me this? Who are you?"

\"E_80001_Clip06_001\".m_mContent: "First an explosion, now a pack of crazed metal beasts attacking us—"

\"E_80001_Clip06_002\".m_mContent: "Honestly! Where in blazes did Noah run off to? He's the one who told us not to split up!"

\"E_80001_Clip06_003\".m_mContent: "Aiona—what are you doing? Why are you tearing those bottles off the spiders?"

\"E_80001_Clip06_004\".m_mContent: "I believe the fluid within them may be the cause of the explosion."

\"E_80001_Clip06_005\".m_mContent: "I saw it. The blast originated here."

\"E_80001_Clip06_006\".m_mContent: "But it was just water—why would water explode?"

\"E_80001_Clip06_007\".m_mContent: "It isn't water. It's an unstable synthetic compound… It's alchemy, after all."

\"E_80001_Clip06_010\".m_mContent: "They might be the ones behind the explosion—seize them!"

\"E_80001_Clip06_011\".m_mContent: "I'm so sorry! I saw her holding the bottle and assumed you were the attackers..."

\"E_80001_Clip06_012\".m_mContent: "You were caught in the blast too? And you're actually investigating the cause?"

\"E_80001_Clip06_013\".m_mContent: "...There's someone more reckless than that dumb wolf."

\"E_80001_Clip06_015\".m_mContent: "That voice, that face... you're Vice-Commander Piera of Bell Ringer Albrecht, aren't you?"

\"E_80001_Clip06_017\".m_mContent: "Piera is my granddaughter! We may look alike, but we're generations apart, I assure you."

\"E_80001_Clip06_020\".m_mContent: "Not nearly as rude as someone who attacks first and asks questions later!"

\"E_80001_Clip06_021\".m_mContent: "Uhh... you're right. That one's on me."

\"E_80001_Clip06_023\".m_mContent: "What do you mean 'didn't actually try'... Wait, Noah? That insufferable silver-haired menace?!"

\"E_80001_Clip06_026\".m_mContent: "He really does have knack for acquainting himself with strange women."

\"E_80001_Clip06_027\".m_mContent: "Listen, whoever's with him right now is extremely dangerous!"

\"E_80001_Clip07_003\".m_mContent: "That's not blood. Those machines have never pulsed with life."

\"E_80001_Clip07_004\".m_mContent: "A thick fog engulfed the sun back in my home, plunged everything into a black mire that devoured all light."

\"E_80001_Clip07_005\".m_mContent: "The air turned rank and bitter, poisoning every wellspring. Decay clung to everything and drained all life."

\"E_80001_Clip07_006\".m_mContent: "Our world is nothing like yours. Only a few of us remain, clinging to the remnants of a world long gone."

\"E_80001_Clip07_008\".m_mContent: "It's nice that you trust me so quickly, but you’re standing a little too close."

\"E_80001_Clip07_009\".m_mContent: "Sorry. I don't know why, but I feel drawn to you. As if there's something I need to understand."

\"E_80001_Clip07_010\".m_mContent: "This is the first time I've ever felt this way."

\"E_80001_Clip07_011\".m_mContent: "Don't overthink it. It's the resonance between us... Noahs."

\"E_80001_Clip07_015\".m_mContent: "We'll talk after. Once they're dealt with, I want to know why you came here."

\"E_80001_Clip07_016\".m_mContent: "It wasn't just a feeling then. You and I—"

\"E_80001_Clip07_017\".m_mContent: "Different weapons, but our movements, the way we think… So this is what it means to share the name 'Noah.'"

\"E_80001_Clip07_018\".m_mContent: "Let me introduce myself. I am Noah Nevernight."

\"E_80001_Clip07_020\".m_mContent: "You're… the other me. From the Other Side."

\"E_80001_Clip07_021\".m_mContent: "Or perhaps you are the other me."

\"E_80001_Clip07_022\".m_mContent: "Well then, how did you get here?"

\"E_80001_Clip07_023\".m_mContent: "Our worlds are clearly at different stages of development. So how do you know what's going to happen in mine?"

\"E_80001_Clip07_024\".m_mContent: "If you're truly me… you won't beat around the bush. Those two answers may well be one and the same."

\"E_80001_Clip07_025\".m_mContent: "Noah! There you are—What are you doing all the way out here?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_001\".m_mContent: "You vanished without a word! Do you have any idea how long we've been searching for you!?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_003\".m_mContent: "Good thing I could track your scent. With this crowd, we never would've found you otherwise—"

\"E_80001_Clip08_004\".m_mContent: "Wait. Speaking of scent… Why are there two of you!?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_006\".m_mContent: "And now another woman appears out of nowhere—acting like she knows me?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_009\".m_mContent: "I can't believe it's really you. How's Piera?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_010\".m_mContent: "The last I remember, she was struck down by Death and then…"

\"E_80001_Clip08_013\".m_mContent: "How do you know this granny’s granddaughter? Seriously—how many odd people do you know?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_015\".m_mContent: "Before you say anything to me, let's deal with them first..."

\"E_80001_Clip08_018\".m_mContent: "You're someone's grandmother, and the one you're looking for is behind Noah."

\"E_80001_Clip08_019\".m_mContent: "So who are you, and who is she?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_020\".m_mContent: "Wait—so she's who? You're who? Who’s with who? And who even am I!?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_021\".m_mContent: "That's Regina, a Gravekeeper from the Paracelsus family. She helped me back on Sunset Isle."

\"E_80001_Clip08_022\".m_mContent: "And this… is Stella. She's from the Other Side—another world's Noah."

\"E_80001_Clip08_023\".m_mContent: "She's you… from the Other Side? She certainly speaks as if she knows us."

\"E_80001_Clip08_025\".m_mContent: "Wait—how does she know who we are? Noah, have you been talking about us?"

\"E_80001_Clip08_026\".m_mContent: "No… I haven't had the chance to."

\"E_80001_Clip09_001\".m_mContent: "So those metal creatures you mentioned… they're from your world?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_002\".m_mContent: "And in that world—do we exist as well?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_003\".m_mContent: "Are we strong? Are we awesome? And why didn't they come with you?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_007\".m_mContent: "Her world is about to be annihilated and she faces it alone without companions to fight by her side."

\"E_80001_Clip09_008\".m_mContent: "(sniffling) Th-that's so sad... But... you've got us now!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_009\".m_mContent: "Hold on—didn't that old woman just say she was dangerous?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_010\".m_mContent: "No, no. I meant… she is in danger."

\"E_80001_Clip09_013\".m_mContent: "So the danger… is from these spiders?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_015\".m_mContent: "You were their target all this time?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_017\".m_mContent: "What? The whole world? From those pathetic metal scraps?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_018\".m_mContent: "They're tough for sure. But even if a thousand more show up, I'll knock them out!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_019\".m_mContent: "They just keep coming. No matter how many we destroy, more take their place—"

\"E_80001_Clip09_020\".m_mContent: "That's why they're so terrifying. They don't bleed. They don't stop."

\"E_80001_Clip09_021\".m_mContent: "Who created them? And why? I've never seen any future like this in my visions."

\"E_80001_Clip09_022\".m_mContent: "Alchemists created them. At first, they were nothing more than laborers—metal shells made to serve."

\"E_80001_Clip09_023\".m_mContent: "So what, all this started because she brought those metal scraps here."

\"E_80001_Clip09_025\".m_mContent: "Long before I arrived, they were already lying in wait."

\"E_80001_Clip09_026\".m_mContent: "Starting right here, in Asta—just as they did in mine."

\"E_80001_Clip09_027\".m_mContent: "Then… are all our worlds bound to the same fate?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_028\".m_mContent: "And you came here just to warn us?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_029\".m_mContent: "There's no point in us escaping, right? They'll continue tearing this place apart!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_030\".m_mContent: "Well, look who grew a brain. Are you the dumb wolf from the Other Side?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_031\".m_mContent: "I came here seeking allies to fight with me."

\"E_80001_Clip09_032\".m_mContent: "But when I saw you… Empousa, Aiona, Hati... When I saw you alive… all I could think of was keeping you safe."

\"E_80001_Clip09_033\".m_mContent: "You shouldn't be dragged into a war that doesn't concern you."

\"E_80001_Clip09_034\".m_mContent: "So you crossed over here… only to face it all alone?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_035\".m_mContent: "But this place is already being pulled into chaos. We can't stand by and watch."

\"E_80001_Clip09_036\".m_mContent: "If you truly don't want to burden us… then help us."

\"E_80001_Clip09_037\".m_mContent: "Tell us their weaknesses and fight by our sides."

\"E_80001_Clip09_038\".m_mContent: "No. They evolve without end. We can't defeat them alone."

\"E_80001_Clip09_039\".m_mContent: "What? Not even with you and Noah? Wasn't that the whole reason you came here?"

\"E_80001_Clip09_040\".m_mContent: "Noah is important, but he's not the only one. There's another just as crucial to this war."

\"E_80001_Clip09_042\".m_mContent: "Ugh. Speak of the devil—here they come again!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_043\".m_mContent: "Wait. Don’t attack. These ones are… different."

\"E_80001_Clip09_044\".m_mContent: "How different? They’re still walking piles of metal!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_046\".m_mContent: "These blue spiders followed me here from another world. They came to protect me."

\"E_80001_Clip09_047\".m_mContent: "Look—those spiders are avoiding us… They're headed that way!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_048\".m_mContent: "...Perhaps they've sensed another 'master' in this world."

\"E_80001_Clip09_050\".m_mContent: "The greatest alchemist of them all. The one who can turn even these machines into our allies—Albrecht."

\"E_80001_Clip09_051\".m_mContent: "Ah, of course! That old eccentric who told me you were in danger and sent me after you! Our very own Albrecht!"

\"E_80001_Clip09_052\".m_mContent: "Then what are we standing around for? Let's follow those metal scraps and find him!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_001\".m_mContent: "And to think they call Asta one of the liveliest cities on the continent? It's dead quiet! Not much more exciting than Mouret."

\"E_80001_Clip10_002\".m_mContent: "Ugh, don't remind me. Tonight was supposed to be the height of Asta's Harvest Festival!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_003\".m_mContent: "Just a few hours ago, the streets were packed—see those bonfires? They were meant to blaze through the night."

\"E_80001_Clip10_004\".m_mContent: "But then those wretched metal beasts showed up and threw everything into chaos. Now the whole city's shut indoors..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_006\".m_mContent: "Don't tell me you've already forgotten what we're here for, you silly wolf!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_007\".m_mContent: "Aren't we here to deal with those metal scraps..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_008\".m_mContent: "No, you dumb wolf! It's the Harvest Festival! Must every thought in your head be about fighting?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_009\".m_mContent: "Now that you mention it... there were no sightings of alchemical constructs before we arrived in Asta."

\"E_80001_Clip10_010\".m_mContent: "Why did they appear today, of all days?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_011\".m_mContent: "I don't know why it happened today... But back home..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_012\".m_mContent: "...my world's Asta was invaded by those constructs on the day of the Harvest Festival."

\"E_80001_Clip10_013\".m_mContent: "And everything that followed... played out exactly as I told you."

\"E_80001_Clip10_014\".m_mContent: "But what if they came because you did?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_015\".m_mContent: "You're the dumb one, silly bat! She just said those metal scraps were already lying in wait before she even showed up!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_016\".m_mContent: "Not necessarily. Maybe it was her arrival that woke them up."

\"E_80001_Clip10_017\".m_mContent: "That's not it. I came here to stop them."

\"E_80001_Clip10_018\".m_mContent: "So in stopping it... she may have caused it?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_021\".m_mContent: "The blue constructs… they've gone completely still."

\"E_80001_Clip10_023\".m_mContent: "That's impossible! We should still be halfway to Albrecht's workshop..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_025\".m_mContent: "This… I feel like I've seen it before. Don't tell me the sky's about to fall again, like on Sunset Isle?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_026\".m_mContent: "No, it looks like something tore it open—"

\"E_80001_Clip10_027\".m_mContent: "The resemblance is stronger now! This is exactly what happened on Sunset Isle!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_028\".m_mContent: "No, it's not the sky—it's more of those metal scraps—!!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_031\".m_mContent: "How many more are pouring through that rift?!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_032\".m_mContent: "I told you... they're endless. So long as the 'Mastermind' exists."

\"E_80001_Clip10_033\".m_mContent: "'Mastermind'? You mean your world's equivalent of the Divine Body?"

\"E_80001_Clip10_035\".m_mContent: "Someone help me—! I... I can't die here!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_036\".m_mContent: "Aeon have mercy on us... Seth, protect..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_037\".m_mContent: "Why are civilians still outside?! Get indoors—hurry!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_038\".m_mContent: "They're getting in our way... But we can't just leave them… Ugh, what a mess!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_039\".m_mContent: "If I unleash Death's power now... it may take them with it—"

\"E_80001_Clip10_041\".m_mContent: "The most fascinating trait of humanity is that no matter how grim the hour..."

\"E_80001_Clip10_042\".m_mContent: "There are always fools who cling to the notion of salvation. Covenant—!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_043\".m_mContent: "What—?! Why did they all just blow up on their own?!"

\"E_80001_Clip10_044\".m_mContent: "Their power source is water… and as it happens, every drop of water in this world answers to me."

\"E_80001_Clip10_046\".m_mContent: "A pleasure to make your acquaintance. The other me... did he not come?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_001\".m_mContent: "According to Albrecht, this place—what was once a bell tower—now serves as a gateway to another world."

\"E_80001_Clip11_002\".m_mContent: "Asta was the beginning of our descent toward the end... and perhaps, it may yet become the place where salvation begins."

\"E_80001_Clip11_003\".m_mContent: "All I have to do... is lie here—between the past and the future."

\"E_80001_Clip11_004\".m_mContent: "I cannot say for certain whether I'll reach the other side in one piece. But—"

\"E_80001_Clip11_005\".m_mContent: "Rather than await a doomed present, I'd rather entrust everything to the unknown Other Side."

\"E_80001_Clip11_006\".m_mContent: "If I can reach Asta before it falls, I can still contact the other Albrecht."

\"E_80001_Clip11_007\".m_mContent: "Even a single drop of 'water' may be enough to alter the course of history."

\"E_80001_Clip11_008\".m_mContent: "So it really was your Albrecht—the one from your world—who sent you to warn us?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_010\".m_mContent: "Our world no longer has the Church's protection. Even Albrecht has lost the blessing of Silver Blood."

\"E_80001_Clip11_011\".m_mContent: "The passage between worlds rends flesh from bone—and without immortality, he wouldn't survive the journey."

\"E_80001_Clip11_013\".m_mContent: "I was born from Death... only to be cast aside by it long ago."

\"E_80001_Clip11_014\".m_mContent: "Those constructs lack flesh and blood—they were never alive. That may be why they pass between worlds so easily… slipping through the rift at will."

\"E_80001_Clip11_015\".m_mContent: "Must we truly have this conversation here? The stench in this place is vile!"

\"E_80001_Clip11_016\".m_mContent: "I endure it not because I must, but because I owe no explanations to the ignorant."

\"E_80001_Clip11_017\".m_mContent: "What's so special about a few jars and flasks?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_018\".m_mContent: "Within every alchemist's workshop lie creations capable of reshaping the world."

\"E_80001_Clip11_020\".m_mContent: "It's no exaggeration. To ordinary folk, an alchemist is a genius."

\"E_80001_Clip11_021\".m_mContent: "But such geniuses often spend their lives crafting things meant to reshape the world—"

\"E_80001_Clip11_022\".m_mContent: "And here, in this man's workshop, those works lie scattered in plain view."

\"E_80001_Clip11_023\".m_mContent: "Enough talk! Let this ancient genius tell us how we're meant to fend off those monsters!"

\"E_80001_Clip11_024\".m_mContent: "Exactly. Didn't you once say you love to solve every problem? Then solve this."

\"E_80001_Clip11_026\".m_mContent: "By my calculations, the probability of successful resistance is… zero."

\"E_80001_Clip11_027\".m_mContent: "As Miss Death had said, that world's 'Mastermind' has near-limitless creative capacity."

\"E_80001_Clip11_028\".m_mContent: "Even when I invoked Covenant just now, the results were clear:"

\"E_80001_Clip11_029\".m_mContent: "Our rate of elimination is vastly outpaced by their rate of creation."

\"E_80001_Clip11_030\".m_mContent: "What?! So even you don't have a solution, Four-Eyes?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_031\".m_mContent: "Got my hopes up for nothing. What a letdown..."

\"E_80001_Clip11_032\".m_mContent: "So after all that clever talk, we're still the ones left to figure things out?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_035\".m_mContent: "At last, someone who grasps the rhythm of my thought."

\"E_80001_Clip11_036\".m_mContent: "Indeed, I said we cannot halt their invasion. But what if…"

\"E_80001_Clip11_037\".m_mContent: "We turned the tide—by invading their world instead?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_040\".m_mContent: "So bold—to pursue all the way here, certain in the belief that you cannot be erased or destroyed."

\"E_80001_Clip11_041\".m_mContent: "Very well. Allow me a moment to prepare. I leave the battlefield to you—consider it your first trial."

\"E_80001_Clip11_042\".m_mContent: "Let's see whether you're fit to be the key pieces in the stratagem I've begun to design."

\"E_80001_Clip11_043\".m_mContent: "Seriously? We cleared out all those metal scraps just so you could grab a bottle?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_044\".m_mContent: "I realize this may be… difficult for the ignorant to grasp, but this bottle holds the entirety of Miss Death's world."

\"E_80001_Clip11_046\".m_mContent: "Your world has been here from the start."

\"E_80001_Clip11_047\".m_mContent: "So this is what Aiona meant by something that could change the world…?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_049\".m_mContent: "So our method of 'invading' that world... is to squeeze ourselves into this bottle?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_050\".m_mContent: "Why are you so quick to believe that? You really think my entire world fits inside this tiny bottle?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_051\".m_mContent: "The silver-haired one is right—yes. The other silver-haired one is wrong—no."

\"E_80001_Clip11_053\".m_mContent: "When you don't know how to answer a question—where should you seek the solution?"

\"E_80001_Clip11_055\".m_mContent: "The one who asked it, of course."

\"E_80001_Clip12_001\".m_mContent: "Then why bring us to this bell tower if we're meant to use this bottle?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_002\".m_mContent: "How little you people understand what a ritual truly entails."

\"E_80001_Clip12_003\".m_mContent: "So what are you trying to do?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_004\".m_mContent: "Perhaps Miss Death would have a better understanding."

\"E_80001_Clip12_005\".m_mContent: "So the bell tower Stella mentioned when she arrived..."

\"E_80001_Clip12_007\".m_mContent: "The me from her world used this very bell tower as an anchor—to drive her, the wedge, into ours."

\"E_80001_Clip12_008\".m_mContent: "And now, through that same point... I shall 'invade' their world in return."

\"E_80001_Clip12_009\".m_mContent: "But you said her world exists inside the bottle, didn't you?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_010\".m_mContent: "Indeed. Every particle and everything that constitutes her world lies sealed within this bottle... forged by my own hand."

\"E_80001_Clip12_011\".m_mContent: "Then why not just smash the bottle? Wouldn't that wipe out all those metal scraps at once?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_012\".m_mContent: "In any world, the one who creates it... is not always the one who writes its laws."

\"E_80001_Clip12_013\".m_mContent: "Are you suggesting Aeon is the same?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_014\".m_mContent: "A Bell Ringer should know better than to even suggest such blasphemy."

\"E_80001_Clip12_015\".m_mContent: "Honestly, I cannot say whether shattering the bottle would destroy that world..."

\"E_80001_Clip12_016\".m_mContent: "—or quite the opposite. It may unleash its contents entirely... And invade this world instead."

\"E_80001_Clip12_017\".m_mContent: "So I propose we let this silver-haired young lady try. After all—it is her world."

\"E_80001_Clip12_019\".m_mContent: "This isn't something she should bear alone."

\"E_80001_Clip12_020\".m_mContent: "Then let us make proper use of the singularity she carried to this side. After all, it was the me from her world who uncovered it."

\"E_80001_Clip12_021\".m_mContent: "Sounds like that version of you is smarter."

\"E_80001_Clip12_022\".m_mContent: "If I'm not mistaken, time flows more swiftly in that world. He's simply had longer to work."

\"E_80001_Clip12_023\".m_mContent: "He did mention it once... That a single bell toll here might span ten years back home."

\"E_80001_Clip12_025\".m_mContent: "Then your so-called 'Mastermind' has had far more time to create those tireless constructs."

\"E_80001_Clip12_026\".m_mContent: "So you're suggesting we enter that world and destroy the source that controls them all?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_027\".m_mContent: "If these things are alchemical in origin, powered by liquid catalysts, then destroying the 'Mastermind' might be the only way to end this."

\"E_80001_Clip12_028\".m_mContent: "That is why the me from over there sent our silver-haired guest to us."

\"E_80001_Clip12_029\".m_mContent: "To face a 'Mastermind' like that... would take at least two of me—and two of you. Now, lead the way."

\"E_80001_Clip12_031\".m_mContent: "Again!? What does it take to shake these pests off!?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_034\".m_mContent: "The hand that tore the sky! Why did it come here?!"

\"E_80001_Clip12_035\".m_mContent: "We'll deal with this! Noah—go! Take them to the bell tower!"

\"E_80001_Clip12_037\".m_mContent: "Even if we tried to stop you, you'd still go, wouldn't you?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_038\".m_mContent: "Besides, Four-eyes said we can't cross over anyway."

\"E_80001_Clip12_039\".m_mContent: "Noah, when you're done, you'd better come back, got it?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_040\".m_mContent: "Even though I'm from there... I never learned how to return."

\"E_80001_Clip12_041\".m_mContent: "As the 'wedge,' you make it easy to trace your point of entry."

\"E_80001_Clip12_043\".m_mContent: "...Shouldn't we declare something suitably dramatic before departure?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_044\".m_mContent: "Once we return... can we truly save the world?"

\"E_80001_Clip12_045\".m_mContent: "I honestly don't know if I have any right to ask this—to pull you into a crisis that doesn't even belong to your world."

\"E_80001_Clip12_046\".m_mContent: "Maybe it was my arrival that awakened them in the first place..."

\"E_80001_Clip12_047\".m_mContent: "I asked for a single line—what I got was three questions."

\"E_80001_Clip12_050\".m_mContent: "Well, I am! Take me with you—"

\"E_80001_Clip12_053\".m_mContent: "No need for concern. What I achieved there, I can replicate here—this passage will carry them through safely."

\"E_80001_Clip12_056\".m_mContent: "But Regina—she's just an ordinary person! That passage could tear her apart—"

\"E_80001_Clip12_057\".m_mContent: "Oh? Now that is fascinating... Perhaps the passage won’t tear her apart at all."

\"E_80001_Clip12_058\".m_mContent: "In fact, she may well become our secret weapon."

\"E_80001_Clip12_059\".m_mContent: "Captain, something's not right. I'm picking up four unknown signals nearby..."

\"E_80001_Clip12_061\".m_mContent: "Not necessarily—there may still be other survivors out there besides us."

\"E_80001_Clip12_063\".m_mContent: "Do you even need to ask? Of course she'll bring us. Any shot at turning the tide is worth the risk..."

\"E_90001_Clip01_001\".m_mContent: "That signal from earlier—it has to be her."

\"E_90001_Clip01_002\".m_mContent: "A fall from that height should've killed her. Should we toss her over?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_003\".m_mContent: "No, wait—she's breathing. We can still save her."

\"E_90001_Clip01_004\".m_mContent: "We detected four signals before. Where are the others?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_007\".m_mContent: "Ugh… my head… feels like my body's been torn apart…"

\"E_90001_Clip01_008\".m_mContent: "Looks like we've got another mouth to feed."

\"E_90001_Clip01_011\".m_mContent: "Lucky for you, the El Dorado broke your fall."

\"E_90001_Clip01_012\".m_mContent: "El... Dorado? Such a fancy name… Wait—if I'm still alive, that means we actually made it to Stella's homeland!?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_014\".m_mContent: "Forget that! Did you see anyone else—was anyone else with me?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_015\".m_mContent: "Two more fell. That who you're talking about?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_017\".m_mContent: "The El Dorado's flying speed has its limitations. You were the only one we could save."

\"E_90001_Clip01_021\".m_mContent: "Blast it! Those metal constructs found us!"

\"E_90001_Clip01_022\".m_mContent: "Bob, William—protect the lady. I'll check in with Captain Ami about our next move."

\"E_90001_Clip01_023\".m_mContent: "Phew... Lucky there weren't many of them—and the Formless didn't appear. Otherwise, we'd be in real trouble."

\"E_90001_Clip01_024\".m_mContent: "What about you? Are you feeling any better?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_025\".m_mContent: "Much better than before... The dizziness is mostly gone. Wait—no!"

\"E_90001_Clip01_026\".m_mContent: "What is this place? It looks like a ship, but... I don't hear any waves?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_029\".m_mContent: "Ahem. I'm the captain. The welcoming speech should be mine to say."

\"E_90001_Clip01_030\".m_mContent: "Wait—a dirigible?! No wonder I couldn't hear any waves... We're in the sky!"

\"E_90001_Clip01_031\".m_mContent: "Captain Ami, we picked up four signals. One was this young lady, and two we couldn't reach in time... So where's the fourth?"

\"E_90001_Clip01_033\".m_mContent: "At least they haven't seen me yet. I just need to reach Regina—but I can't be spotted..."

\"E_90001_Clip01_034\".m_mContent: "Oh, if you mean her—she's right over there."

\"E_90001_Clip01_036\".m_mContent: "Stella? Come here! It's fine—these people are friends."

\"E_90001_Clip01_037\".m_mContent: "She's far too trusting for her own good."

\"E_90001_Clip02_001\".m_mContent: "Even amid the devastation, you can still glimpse what Asta once was."

\"E_90001_Clip02_002\".m_mContent: "But though it's still Asta, everything has changed."

\"E_90001_Clip02_003\".m_mContent: "Shattered pipes strewn across the ground... wreckage that looks like ships. Could they truly fly through the skies?"

\"E_90001_Clip02_004\".m_mContent: "So, you've made it here in one piece. I must admit—your descent was far more graceful than expected. But given... present circumstances, perhaps some mysteries are best left unanswered."

\"E_90001_Clip02_005\".m_mContent: "So this is Miss Death's homeland? Intriguing. I see contraptions I've never encountered before."

\"E_90001_Clip02_006\".m_mContent: "Given time, I'm sure you could recreate them yourself."

\"E_90001_Clip02_007\".m_mContent: "And yet the world teeters on the brink of ruination. Which is precisely why we've come, isn't it?"

\"E_90001_Clip02_011\".m_mContent: "Why didn't you use Covenant during the fight? Like before—when you bailed us out."

\"E_90001_Clip02_012\".m_mContent: "I tried. It's useless. The water here... its structure is completely alien. Until I understand how it's composed, I can't manipulate this world's 'water.'"

\"E_90001_Clip02_014\".m_mContent: "For ordinary mortals? Ten years, give or take."

\"E_90001_Clip02_016\".m_mContent: "But for a genius like myself? Ten days."

\"E_90001_Clip02_017\".m_mContent: "We may not have ten days. This world is falling apart around us."

\"E_90001_Clip02_018\".m_mContent: "And yet... that's exactly how much time I need. Tell me, who do you think sent that 'star' to beg for my help?"

\"E_90001_Clip02_020\".m_mContent: "The version of me fighting this world's constructs... He must've started his research long ago."

\"E_90001_Clip02_021\".m_mContent: "If I can find what he left behind, I'll have everything I need to strike back."

\"E_90001_Clip02_022\".m_mContent: "You mean... the Albrecht from this world?"

\"E_90001_Clip02_024\".m_mContent: "That distinction is meaningless to an alchemist. What matters isn't where he's from, but..."

\"E_90001_Clip03_001\".m_mContent: "Hey, is it just me, or are there fewer of those metal creatures?"

\"E_90001_Clip03_002\".m_mContent: "It's likely connected to Noah and the others reaching the Other Side."

\"E_90001_Clip03_004\".m_mContent: "Or rather that hand pursued Stella back to where it came from."

\"E_90001_Clip03_005\".m_mContent: "If we eliminate these enemies, the city should be safe for now?"

\"E_90001_Clip03_007\".m_mContent: "Finally, some good news! Let's clear them out—fast!"

\"E_90001_Clip03_008\".m_mContent: "But... where will that hand strike next?"

\"E_90001_Clip03_009\".m_mContent: "...I already know your names and identities, and I believe you should have the same goal as I do. But her—"

\"E_90001_Clip03_010\".m_mContent: "The one who won't meet my gaze and hasn't stopped eating."

\"E_90001_Clip03_011\".m_mContent: "This one's Brad… gulp... smells amazing. Want a bite?"

\"E_90001_Clip03_012\".m_mContent: "No. I just want to know who you are."

\"E_90001_Clip03_013\".m_mContent: "Me? I'm the world's last hope, captain of the legendary Ultimate El Dorado, and the greatest adventurer alive—"

\"E_90001_Clip03_016\".m_mContent: "Now that we know each other's names, we're all companions!"

\"E_90001_Clip03_018\".m_mContent: "It's the Formless! It's slicing through space—it's about to manifest—!"

\"E_90001_Clip04_002\".m_mContent: "It's a weapon the Mastermind uses to force its way into our world. It's controlling all those alchemical constructs."

\"E_90001_Clip04_003\".m_mContent: "I've fought that thing for years—even followed it to the Other Side—and this is the first time I'm hearing what it's called."

\"E_90001_Clip04_004\".m_mContent: "The Other Side? So that's where you're from. Explains why you dropped in out of nowhere."

\"E_90001_Clip04_005\".m_mContent: "I was only there for a day."

\"E_90001_Clip04_006\".m_mContent: "Time flows differently on each 'Other Side.' The fastest one—one day there equals seven years here."

\"E_90001_Clip04_007\".m_mContent: "It can reach the Other Sides because it exists outside time and space."

\"E_90001_Clip04_008\".m_mContent: "I'd love to hear more, but it's getting closer!"

\"E_90001_Clip04_010\".m_mContent: "Return to port. If we can't close the Gates, we're wasting our time here."

\"E_90001_Clip04_012\".m_mContent: "Little Regina, did you see the rifts torn open by the Formless? Those are Gates—pathways between worlds."

\"E_90001_Clip04_013\".m_mContent: "Hey! Less chatter, more action! They're boarding through the Gates!"

\"E_90001_Clip04_015\".m_mContent: "Can you take them all on your own?"

\"E_90001_Clip04_016\".m_mContent: "No one knows those constructs better than I do."

\"E_90001_Clip04_018\".m_mContent: "The deck should be clear of constructs now. Still, you may want to check inside the ship—some might have slipped through."

\"E_90001_Clip04_019\".m_mContent: "Little Stella... You really are something else!"

\"E_90001_Clip04_021\".m_mContent: "She was the girl chosen to light the harvest bonfire at Asta's festival, nineteen years ago."

\"E_90001_Clip04_022\".m_mContent: "That would make her rather old now."

\"E_90001_Clip04_023\".m_mContent: "That was also the day those constructs turned on humanity."

\"E_90001_Clip04_024\".m_mContent: "Speaking of which, you said the Formless used those Gates to unleash those metal creatures—correct?"

\"E_90001_Clip04_025\".m_mContent: "Yes... Whenever a rift opens, another place will vanish from existence."

\"E_90001_Clip04_026\".m_mContent: "Then why don't we just close the Gates? Wouldn't that stop them?"

\"E_90001_Clip04_027\".m_mContent: "Close it? What are you, a child? If that were possible, do you think the world would've come to this?"

\"E_90001_Clip04_028\".m_mContent: "(sighing) If only the Grand Alchemist were still with us... Perhaps then the Gates could've been sealed for good."

\"E_90001_Clip04_029\".m_mContent: "The Grand Alchemist... the one who died? Don't tell me—"

\"E_90001_Clip04_030\".m_mContent: "You don't know? It was that Bell Ringer..."

\"E_90001_Clip04_032\".m_mContent: "Shh—keep your voice down. This place... I've never seen anything like it."

\"E_90001_Clip04_033\".m_mContent: "I'm adrift in an ocean of the unknown."

\"E_90001_Clip05_001\".m_mContent: "I expected something advanced... but this exceeds even my projections."

\"E_90001_Clip05_002\".m_mContent: "So your true purpose here is to explore instead of saving the world?"

\"E_90001_Clip05_003\".m_mContent: "Glory and titles mean little to an alchemist."

\"E_90001_Clip05_004\".m_mContent: "What drives us is truth. The hunger to comprehend the principle of truth."

\"E_90001_Clip05_005\".m_mContent: "From the moment we first melt metal into liquid, we embrace the most primal alchemy. That simple act births all creation."

\"E_90001_Clip05_006\".m_mContent: "And here, within this sanctuary I have carved—Lies the 'key' every alchemist yearns to find."

\"E_90001_Clip05_007\".m_mContent: "That 'key' which transcends time itself, binding all knowledge into one."

\"E_90001_Clip05_008\".m_mContent: "There are countless alchemical creations here you've never seen before."

\"E_90001_Clip05_009\".m_mContent: "Mortals seek answers, yet forget the joy of the pursuit."

\"E_90001_Clip05_010\".m_mContent: "Too bad the constructs outside won't wait for you to enjoy your 'pursuit.'"

\"E_90001_Clip05_012\".m_mContent: "I wonder if 'Death' might buy me the time I need to work through this puzzle."

\"E_90001_Clip05_013\".m_mContent: "Take too long, and I may simply leave you behind—"

\"E_90001_Clip05_014\".m_mContent: "Hmm… so that was my conclusion after all."

\"E_90001_Clip05_015\".m_mContent: "Any later and I'd have fled to avoid your charming little monsters."

\"E_90001_Clip05_016\".m_mContent: "Still, this was worthwhile. Most of my theories hold true—"

\"E_90001_Clip05_017\".m_mContent: "I created this world, yes, but its growth now exceeds my design."

\"E_90001_Clip05_018\".m_mContent: "And what makes you so certain it was your doing?"

\"E_90001_Clip05_019\".m_mContent: "The version of me here has already confirmed it—he's pursuing the exact same research."

\"E_90001_Clip05_020\".m_mContent: "Does every version of you fancy yourself a god? Apparently being Aeon's Bell Ringer isn't enough for you."

\"E_90001_Clip05_021\".m_mContent: "Creation is only a means—a way to trace our origins, to learn how our universe came to be."

\"E_90001_Clip05_022\".m_mContent: "He wants to discover who created him—and this world."

\"E_90001_Clip05_023\".m_mContent: "You both probe at the mysteries of your respective universes—yet in the end, you discovered one another's existence."

\"E_90001_Clip05_024\".m_mContent: "Please, don't phrase it so quaintly. View me as an alchemic scholar—"

\"E_90001_Clip05_025\".m_mContent: "—or better yet, as one who seeks the root truths of existence itself."

\"E_90001_Clip06_001\".m_mContent: "Initially, I sought merely to determine whether beings of higher dimensions dwelt beyond the boundaries of our reality."

\"E_90001_Clip06_002\".m_mContent: "I infused my 'water' into the vessel, and through patient, meticulous refinement, watched a fledgling universe take shape—one that now grows beyond its crystalline cradle."

\"E_90001_Clip06_003\".m_mContent: "Can universes truly be created so easily?"

\"E_90001_Clip06_004\".m_mContent: "'Universe'—is a man-made word. And no... it's not easy."

\"E_90001_Clip06_005\".m_mContent: "So you're not denying that you created this world?"

\"E_90001_Clip06_006\".m_mContent: "I admit, I had doubts about my calculations and was even startled by its progression. You see—"

\"E_90001_Clip06_007\".m_mContent: "I witnessed it firsthand—nothing but ruins left in the wake of creation."

\"E_90001_Clip06_008\".m_mContent: "So if you want to keep them from reaching our world, all you'd need to do is seal the bottle?"

\"E_90001_Clip06_009\".m_mContent: "People look at a bottle and assume all things pass through its mouth."

\"E_90001_Clip06_010\".m_mContent: "But universes are more elusive. Their link to the outer world lies not at the rim, but within."

\"E_90001_Clip06_011\".m_mContent: "So you're telling me the passage between our worlds could be hidden anywhere—in forests, oceans, cities we pass by without a glance..."

\"E_90001_Clip06_012\".m_mContent: "or perhaps... inside that very clock tower."

\"E_90001_Clip06_013\".m_mContent: "Wouldn't you like to know how I discovered such an insignificant point of contact?"

\"E_90001_Clip06_014\".m_mContent: "I'm more curious why you never tried to seal it—even after locating it."

\"E_90001_Clip06_015\".m_mContent: "I do know how to close it. But it seems... an accident occurred."

\"E_90001_Clip06_017\".m_mContent: "It appears to move freely between both worlds without using the passage—and that's the mystery I intend to unravel."

\"E_90001_Clip06_018\".m_mContent: "So I was right. You came here to indulge your curiosity."

\"E_90001_Clip06_023\".m_mContent: "So you've reclaimed dominion over water—a legacy from your other-world self."

\"E_90001_Clip06_024\".m_mContent: "Then allow me to ignite these—a grand display, visible even from the other side."

\"E_90001_Clip06_026\".m_mContent: "What's that in the sky? It's so bright... and shimmering..."

\"E_90001_Clip07_001\".m_mContent: "Wasn't today's celebration canceled because of those metal beasts? Why are there still fireworks?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_002\".m_mContent: "Those aren't fireworks. They're a message from another world."

\"E_90001_Clip07_003\".m_mContent: "Another world... you mean Noah and the others!?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_005\".m_mContent: "Now that the hand has vanished, we must seize the moment to destroy what remains."

\"E_90001_Clip07_006\".m_mContent: "So that Asta may one day see real fireworks again."

\"E_90001_Clip07_007\".m_mContent: "I don't really get it, but... we just smash those metal creatures, right?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_008\".m_mContent: "We hold the line. At least until Noah and the others return."

\"E_90001_Clip07_009\".m_mContent: "It's rather ironic. Individually, these constructs pose no real threat to us."

\"E_90001_Clip07_010\".m_mContent: "But together, under the Mastermind's command, their flawless coordination could bring ruin to entire worlds."

\"E_90001_Clip07_011\".m_mContent: "You truly believe there's a Mastermind behind it all?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_012\".m_mContent: "According to Stella, it controls every construct. If we defeat it, the threat to both worlds ends."

\"E_90001_Clip07_013\".m_mContent: "Do you really believe that? That some supreme will exists—pulling every string, logically controlling everything?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_014\".m_mContent: "Every question you ask makes it harder to see you as just another Bell Ringer."

\"E_90001_Clip07_015\".m_mContent: "You want me to say there's no will. No Mastermind."

\"E_90001_Clip07_016\".m_mContent: "That most people simply crave affirmation... and lose themselves trying to meet others' expectations."

\"E_90001_Clip07_018\".m_mContent: "When Black Blood spreads far enough, its victims merge into one consciousness. They vanish into the swarm, becoming a single, mindless purpose."

\"E_90001_Clip07_019\".m_mContent: "You don't just know it—you've lived it."

\"E_90001_Clip07_020\".m_mContent: "So even these constructs, fleshless as they are, aren't so different from the Blood Beasts."

\"E_90001_Clip07_022\".m_mContent: "People. Life. Even the universe. Strip away their form, and maybe what remains... is the same."

\"E_90001_Clip07_023\".m_mContent: "So what you're saying is we don't need to stop the Mastermind?"

\"E_90001_Clip07_024\".m_mContent: "On the contrary. What happens to humanity is irrelevant to everyone but me."

\"E_90001_Clip07_026\".m_mContent: "Come. Let's find the Mastermind. I believe I know how to deal with it."

\"E_90001_Clip07_027\".m_mContent: "And how exactly are we supposed to track it down?"

\"E_90001_Clip08_002\".m_mContent: "Damn it! We can't stay here—those constructs will swarm El Dorado if we don't move!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_003\".m_mContent: "We sent every last drone to hunt down that Noah guy. And now what!?"

\"E_90001_Clip08_004\".m_mContent: "Please... just a little more time! If Noah got our message, he'll come—he'll bring Albrecht from our world!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_005\".m_mContent: "I don't understand your faith in him. But the reality is, this ship won't survive another assault."

\"E_90001_Clip08_006\".m_mContent: "If it comes to that, I'll have to use metamorphosis..."

\"E_90001_Clip08_007\".m_mContent: "You're all bark when it comes to pain."

\"E_90001_Clip08_008\".m_mContent: "For my family—for everything I care about—I will do it!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_009\".m_mContent: "I'll disembark and draw them away from the ship."

\"E_90001_Clip08_010\".m_mContent: "Stella, don't throw your life away! There are too many of them."

\"E_90001_Clip08_011\".m_mContent: "This is my homeland. If there's even the faintest glimmer of hope, I won't let it go."

\"E_90001_Clip08_014\".m_mContent: "There's our Captain Ami, deep in thought as always!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_015\".m_mContent: "...I think we should have bread for dinner tonight."

\"E_90001_Clip08_016\".m_mContent: "Captain's orders are clear—we wait. This is our homeland too."

\"E_90001_Clip08_017\".m_mContent: "And as her crew, we carry out her will."

\"E_90001_Clip08_019\".m_mContent: "Don't worry. I won't let anything happen to this ship."

\"E_90001_Clip08_021\".m_mContent: "Those metal creatures looking for Noah—that was my doing. I have to take responsibility."

\"E_90001_Clip08_022\".m_mContent: "Regina... I don't know how you even made it across, but you're just an ordinary person. If you get hurt because of me..."

\"E_90001_Clip08_023\".m_mContent: "I don't care if I'm ordinary. First and foremost, I'm your companion!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_024\".m_mContent: "We've known each other for less than a day."

\"E_90001_Clip08_025\".m_mContent: "That's awful! You forgot? One day there is several years here!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_026\".m_mContent: "Either way—I'm not letting you face this alone!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_028\".m_mContent: "Well, that didn't take long... Regina, your safety comes first."

\"E_90001_Clip08_029\".m_mContent: "What's your status?! We're barely holding the line!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_030\".m_mContent: "Tch... These pests hit like hammers, and they just keep coming!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_031\".m_mContent: "This isn't working! We can't keep waiting for your friends. We need another way out—now!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_032\".m_mContent: "Find Ami and the others. I'll hold them off."

\"E_90001_Clip08_033\".m_mContent: "What do you mean? You're going in alone?"

\"E_90001_Clip08_034\".m_mContent: "Like I said—you're just an outsider who got dragged into this."

\"E_90001_Clip08_035\".m_mContent: "What are you talking about?! We're companions now, aren't we?"

\"E_90001_Clip08_036\".m_mContent: "That's why. Because we're companions... I can't lose you..."

\"E_90001_Clip08_037\".m_mContent: "This started because of me—maybe all of it started with me."

\"E_90001_Clip08_038\".m_mContent: "No matter how far I run, they follow... like shadows I can't shake."

\"E_90001_Clip08_039\".m_mContent: "And that's exactly why we're here—to fight them with you!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_040\".m_mContent: "Fall back! They're amassing below—they're climbing the walls!"

\"E_90001_Clip08_041\".m_mContent: "Forgive me, partner... It's been so long since I called someone that."

\"E_90001_Clip09_001\".m_mContent: "(exhaling) I must've been scratched by the brush when I fell from the dirigible."

\"E_90001_Clip09_002\".m_mContent: "Still, this might be the only way to prove my theory."

\"E_90001_Clip09_003\".m_mContent: "If I really am the Formless's target, then Regina and Ami should be able to slip past the encirclement."

\"E_90001_Clip09_004\".m_mContent: "Come to think of it… this jungle looks like the one near Asta."

\"E_90001_Clip09_005\".m_mContent: "If the El Dorado hadn't caught us, Regina and I might've landed near the 'anchor' in the bell tower Albrecht mentioned... I just hope I made the right call."

\"E_90001_Clip09_009\".m_mContent: "Its tone... it's different. Almost melodic—like it's singing?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_011\".m_mContent: "It's blue... one of ours. Modified by our Albrecht. What are you doing here in the forest?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_012\".m_mContent: "You're not one of the scouting drones the El Dorado sent to search for Noah, are you?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_013\".m_mContent: "The Formless's forces will be here any moment. This area isn't safe—get out of sight, quickly."

\"E_90001_Clip09_018\".m_mContent: "You're trying to tell me something, aren't you? I'm sorry—but I still can't understand what you mean."

\"E_90001_Clip09_022\".m_mContent: "Are you trying to warn me that enemies are coming?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_023\".m_mContent: "Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—!"

\"E_90001_Clip09_024\".m_mContent: "Even if you beep faster, I still can't understand you..."

\"E_90001_Clip09_025\".m_mContent: "But anything that doesn't look like you must be an enemy, right?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_026\".m_mContent: "Should I be relieved? I was right. It stopped attacking the El Dorado and came after me instead."

\"E_90001_Clip09_027\".m_mContent: "But why me? Why would the Formless target me?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_029\".m_mContent: "Earlier... you were trying to warn me about the Formless, weren't you?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_031\".m_mContent: "'Stella, run'... That's what you're trying to say, right?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_033\".m_mContent: "I think I'm finally starting to understand you."

\"E_90001_Clip09_034\".m_mContent: "Empousa... our Empousa—the one we lost. She used to..."

\"E_90001_Clip09_035\".m_mContent: "She always had a 'friend' just like you. And she'd always respond when it beeped—just like this."

\"E_90001_Clip09_036\".m_mContent: "I think I believe it now—when hearts truly connect, even language becomes unnecessary."

\"E_90001_Clip09_038\".m_mContent: "I can even understand the Formless now... It wants to eliminate me, doesn't it?"

\"E_90001_Clip09_039\".m_mContent: "I'll draw it away. You go the other way—or stay hidden until it's safe."

\"E_90001_Clip09_043\".m_mContent: "Follow you? You want to take me somewhere?"

\"E_90001_Clip10_002\".m_mContent: "While I was on the Other Side, so many years passed here... Everything's in even worse shape than when I left."

\"E_90001_Clip10_004\".m_mContent: "Does it sadden you too, seeing the city like this?"

\"E_90001_Clip10_005\".m_mContent: "Still, we've put good distance between us and the El Dorado—enough, I hope, for Regina and the others to escape the Formless."

\"E_90001_Clip10_006\".m_mContent: "By now, the other 'me' should have found his way back to them. He and that world's Albrecht... they seemed dependable."

\"E_90001_Clip10_007\".m_mContent: "If anyone can make it back home, it's them."

\"E_90001_Clip10_008\".m_mContent: "Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—?"

\"E_90001_Clip10_009\".m_mContent: "You're asking 'why don't I go with you?'"

\"E_90001_Clip10_010\".m_mContent: "After losing everything... I finally found someone who sees me as a companion."

\"E_90001_Clip10_011\".m_mContent: "They were dragged into this because of me… I won't let them be caught up in it any further."

\"E_90001_Clip10_012\".m_mContent: "Captain Ami, the crew of the El Dorado—they’ve made it this far. I trust they’ll keep the others safe."

\"E_90001_Clip10_013\".m_mContent: "If luring the Formless away is the only atonement left to me... then so be it."

\"E_90001_Clip10_014\".m_mContent: "Rain... How long has it been since I last felt it?"

\"E_90001_Clip10_015\".m_mContent: "Ever since the constructs rebelled, the Mastermind has cloaked this world in endless fog..."

\"E_90001_Clip10_018\".m_mContent: "Well, I've already seen them again—my companions from that world. Alive, and well."

\"E_90001_Clip10_019\".m_mContent: "So now... perhaps I can finally say farewell to this one."

\"E_90001_Clip10_021\".m_mContent: "Come, then. Let me show you the weight of my resolve."

\"E_90001_Clip10_023\".m_mContent: "To return 'Death' to the void... even the Mastermind would find that near impossible."

\"E_90001_Clip10_024\".m_mContent: "Keep fighting me. The longer you're kept here, the better their chances of escaping safely."

\"E_90001_Clip10_025\".m_mContent: "And when that moment comes... I'll fulfill what I was meant to do."

\"E_90001_Clip10_027\".m_mContent: "Asta's fireworks... I would give anything to see them once more."

\"E_90001_Clip10_029\".m_mContent: "Forgive me, Regina... I have to find the companions I lost."

\"E_90001_Clip10_031\".m_mContent: "Why are you still following me? Now's your chance—while the Formless rests, get to safety."

\"E_90001_Clip10_033\".m_mContent: "...You want me to come with you?"

\"E_90001_Clip10_036\".m_mContent: "That place... Is that where Aiona and the others died?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_002\".m_mContent: "There's nothing remarkable here. Why bring me to this place?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_005\".m_mContent: "Even if I forget everything about myself one day... This place—I will never forget. Where they came swarming. Where my companions were devoured."

\"E_90001_Clip11_007\".m_mContent: "Hmm? Who are you calling out to?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_008\".m_mContent: "Wait! Could it be Aiona and the others..."

\"E_90001_Clip11_010\".m_mContent: "...You're right. I shouldn't have let myself believe they were still alive."

\"E_90001_Clip11_013\".m_mContent: "So you brought me here... to meet your companions?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_015\".m_mContent: "I'm grateful... but there's something more pressing I must do."

\"E_90001_Clip11_016\".m_mContent: "I must hold off the Formless. Buy Albrecht time to lead Regina and the others home."

\"E_90001_Clip11_017\".m_mContent: "I don't know if she ever truly saw me as a companion. But even so—"

\"E_90001_Clip11_018\".m_mContent: "I will not stand by and watch another sacrifice themselves in my place."

\"E_90001_Clip11_019\".m_mContent: "When I sought out Albrecht, I only wanted to know how to save this world."

\"E_90001_Clip11_020\".m_mContent: "I never meant to drag her into this. This is not her war to fight."

\"E_90001_Clip11_021\".m_mContent: "I'll keep the Formless at bay. And once they're safe, whether it's the Mastermind or the Construct... I will be the one to end it."

\"E_90001_Clip11_023\".m_mContent: "W-what...? How are you flying around me like that?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_029\".m_mContent: "Am I... crying? But why? They're just artificial constructs, and yet... why does it ache like this?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_031\".m_mContent: "I'll figure it out later. Stay behind me—I'll handle this."

\"E_90001_Clip11_034\".m_mContent: "The Formless must sense my strength fading—so they've gathered their constructs to finish me."

\"E_90001_Clip11_037\".m_mContent: "You've stepped forward... Are you planning to help me hold them off?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_038\".m_mContent: "It's all right. I'll handle it—at least allow me to fulfill my final duty."

\"E_90001_Clip11_041\".m_mContent: "I'm sorry... I can't understand what you're trying to say."

\"E_90001_Clip11_043\".m_mContent: "Wait—stop! Those things are the Formless's constructs! You can't fight them—come back!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_047\".m_mContent: "Stella, go! You have more important matters to deal with!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_048\".m_mContent: "Only you can cross between worlds—as Death incarnate."

\"E_90001_Clip11_049\".m_mContent: "Exactly! We'll hold these constructs off—go find Albrecht!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_053\".m_mContent: "So it wasn't chance that brought us together... All these years I was gone... were you waiting for me?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_056\".m_mContent: "No... I won't let you sacrifice yourselves for me!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_057\".m_mContent: "You're all that's left of my companions in this world. I can't lose you too..."

\"E_90001_Clip11_059\".m_mContent: "Is it happening again...? Come back, now!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_062\".m_mContent: "No... please! Don't go! Don't leave me alone... again..."

\"E_90001_Clip11_066\".m_mContent: "The raindrop I controlled led me to you."

\"E_90001_Clip11_067\".m_mContent: "Thanks to Regina too. If she hadn't told us which way you went, we might never have found you."

\"E_90001_Clip11_071\".m_mContent: "We don't have time for small talk right now."

\"E_90001_Clip11_073\".m_mContent: "None of your attacks even grazed it?"

\"E_90001_Clip11_074\".m_mContent: "It rends space itself. Its capacity for survival far exceeds those crude constructs."

\"E_90001_Clip11_075\".m_mContent: "The next assault will come swiftly—we must prepare..."

\"E_90001_Clip11_078\".m_mContent: "Stella, don't just stand there—get over here! We're nearly out of ammunition. We can't hold them off much longer!"

\"E_90001_Clip11_082\".m_mContent: "Care to join us, you two? The more the merrier."

\"E_90001_Clip12_001\".m_mContent: "Little Stella! (sniffling)... I'm so glad you're still alive!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_002\".m_mContent: "You idiot! Who gave you the right to decide that on your own and just leave me behind?!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_004\".m_mContent: "I just... I couldn't bear to see you get hurt."

\"E_90001_Clip12_005\".m_mContent: "That's no reason to risk drawing the Formless away on your own!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_006\".m_mContent: "You wanted Albrecht to take me back to our world, didn't you? But I told you—we're companions. We face this together."

\"E_90001_Clip12_007\".m_mContent: "Now's not the time to think about returning home. We need to focus on ending this."

\"E_90001_Clip12_008\".m_mContent: "Albrecht has found a way to destroy the Mastermind—and Ami knows where it lies."

\"E_90001_Clip12_010\".m_mContent: "If we've managed to survive under these conditions, then naturally, we know a thing or two about the Mastermind."

\"E_90001_Clip12_011\".m_mContent: "If it can rend space to draw the Formless to our side, then we, too, can cross to theirs—just as I once did."

\"E_90001_Clip12_012\".m_mContent: "But none of us know what we'll find there."

\"E_90001_Clip12_013\".m_mContent: "That's why we came to this world."

\"E_90001_Clip12_014\".m_mContent: "Even if none of us return, if there's a chance to save our world—we must confront the Mastermind. There's no other way."

\"E_90001_Clip12_015\".m_mContent: "Exactly! Stella, stop trying to handle everything alone—trust us!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_016\".m_mContent: "No alchemist can tolerate their work being corrupted by others... Perhaps that's reason enough for me to stay."

\"E_90001_Clip12_019\".m_mContent: "Alright, Bob, hold the tears—we have matters to attend to."

\"E_90001_Clip12_020\".m_mContent: "Then it's settled—full speed toward the Mastermind's domain."

\"E_90001_Clip12_022\".m_mContent: "...have you forgotten that I'm the captain?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_023\".m_mContent: "So this is the Mastermind's realm beyond the rift... fascinating."

\"E_90001_Clip12_024\".m_mContent: "Save the philosophy for later, old man—it's gaining on us!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_026\".m_mContent: "So you are its target after all."

\"E_90001_Clip12_028\".m_mContent: "At first, I could only guess why the me from your world chose you to cross into ours."

\"E_90001_Clip12_029\".m_mContent: "But after all this Albrecht told me... I believe I've found the answer."

\"E_90001_Clip12_030\".m_mContent: "But after I left... he died, didn't he?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_031\".m_mContent: "Indeed. But tell me—when do you think a person truly dies?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_032\".m_mContent: "He asked me the same thing, just before I departed. Then... could it be that you're—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_033\".m_mContent: "He never left. He's been here all along—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_034\".m_mContent: "Why are you pointing at your head?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_035\".m_mContent: "Would you hear my answer? As long as memory and knowledge persist, he cannot truly die."

\"E_90001_Clip12_036\".m_mContent: "Isn't that how human civilization carries on?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_037\".m_mContent: "Wait, hold on—you're losing me... You still haven't explained why the Formless keeps chasing Stella."

\"E_90001_Clip12_038\".m_mContent: "Simple. Because you—Stella Noah—have been the anchor linking our two worlds from the very beginning."

\"E_90001_Clip12_039\".m_mContent: "What? I thought it was the bell tower!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_040\".m_mContent: "The true joy of alchemy lies in combining wholly unlike elements... and observing the reactions that emerge between them."

\"E_90001_Clip12_041\".m_mContent: "So you're saying the reason she crossed into our world—and we into hers—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_042\".m_mContent: "—is because I somehow reacted with the bell tower?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_043\".m_mContent: "If I had to guess... the Formless breached this world during the Harvest Festival nineteen years ago."

\"E_90001_Clip12_044\".m_mContent: "And just how would you know that? Did that memory tell you?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_045\".m_mContent: "Now, then... care to guess why that day, of all days?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_046\".m_mContent: "You old fool! If you already know, then say it!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_049\".m_mContent: "And the one chosen to light the flame... was none other than Stella."

\"E_90001_Clip12_050\".m_mContent: "So it really was me... I'm the one who connected the two worlds?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_051\".m_mContent: "Or rather, they crossed into this world the same way you did."

\"E_90001_Clip12_052\".m_mContent: "So what you're saying... those things came from a world even more distant than ours?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_053\".m_mContent: "To be precise... from the next bottled world."

\"E_90001_Clip12_054\".m_mContent: "In the end, it's still my fault..."

\"E_90001_Clip12_055\".m_mContent: "Not you, but the Law itself. The discovery of a single bottled world affirms the existence of infinite others."

\"E_90001_Clip12_056\".m_mContent: "That Mastermind may have traveled world after world—passing through endless towers, endless reflections of you—to reach this one."

\"E_90001_Clip12_057\".m_mContent: "Then it came through Stella not by chance... but because it sought to rise from our bottled world to something beyond?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_058\".m_mContent: "It seeks anchors—like you—through which to ascend, again and again. Ever reaching upward, in pursuit of higher-dimensional understanding."

\"E_90001_Clip12_059\".m_mContent: "In that sense... the Mastermind may also be a seeker of knowledge. We may even share a common goal."

\"E_90001_Clip12_060\".m_mContent: "Oh, great—here it comes. Since you two get along so well, why don't you go talk it down?!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_062\".m_mContent: "That is precisely my intention. Though I've never cared for waiting idly... I would rather take the initiative and seek it out myself."

\"E_90001_Clip12_064\".m_mContent: "Captain, have you lost your mind?! That path is crawling with constructs!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_065\".m_mContent: "With defenses that thick, there's no mistaking it—the Mastermind must be there."

\"E_90001_Clip12_067\".m_mContent: "We'll have our work cut out for us repairing the El Dorado after this..."

\"E_90001_Clip12_068\".m_mContent: "Kristoph, Bob—are you two serious right now?!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_070\".m_mContent: "I swear... I've no idea why I'm going along with this lunacy."

\"E_90001_Clip12_071\".m_mContent: "Fine! But don't expect me to bail you out when it all goes wrong—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_072\".m_mContent: "Impact's shaken the El Dorado. We're starting to lose speed."

\"E_90001_Clip12_073\".m_mContent: "No matter. We're close enough. Come with me. Let us meet this Mastermind face to face. After all, our world is next on its list."

\"E_90001_Clip12_074\".m_mContent: "Even if Albrecht is right... Even if opening a passage to another World in a Bottle was fated to happen—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_075\".m_mContent: "It doesn't change the truth. It came because of me."

\"E_90001_Clip12_076\".m_mContent: "It shattered the world I knew... and left me with nothing but myself."

\"E_90001_Clip12_077\".m_mContent: "This 'hand' that rends fate... grew from seeds I sowed. Let me be the one to uproot them."

\"E_90001_Clip12_078\".m_mContent: "Then, before our world bears its own poisoned fruit... Let me be the one to wither the seed and sever its bloom."

\"E_90001_Clip12_082\".m_mContent: "—Come with me. Let's face the Enemy we were meant to confront."

\"E_90001_Clip12_086\".m_mContent: "And of course, I haven't forgotten you either."

\"E_90001_Clip12_088\".m_mContent: "Let's strike together and take back all that we've lost!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_089\".m_mContent: "So this is where the Mastermind dwells? There's nothing here. Only emptiness."

\"E_90001_Clip12_090\".m_mContent: "The beginning and end of all things are the same: nothing."

\"E_90001_Clip12_091\".m_mContent: "What do you believe the universe was, before you were born? What do you imagine it becomes, once you are gone?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_092\".m_mContent: "So this is the answer you propose. This place itself—is the Mastermind."

\"E_90001_Clip12_093\".m_mContent: "By my calculations, the Mastermind embodies both everything and nothing."

\"E_90001_Clip12_094\".m_mContent: "It commands the fleshless constructs, sends them to ceaselessly invade the upper layers, and saturates each vessel with void through a web of anchor points."

\"E_90001_Clip12_095\".m_mContent: "It seems, just like the Blood Beasts—seeking to devour all memory, and fuse all will into one."

\"E_90001_Clip12_096\".m_mContent: "This is no mere echo of the Black Blood. It is the primal law of disorder—entropy itself."

\"E_90001_Clip12_097\".m_mContent: "But if it's only chaotic nothingness, how can we possibly stop it?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_098\".m_mContent: "We don't destroy the void. We feed it order—until it consumes itself."

\"E_90001_Clip12_099\".m_mContent: "So to give the void form... we need a conscious will. A new Mastermind."

\"E_90001_Clip12_104\".m_mContent: "Fascinating, isn't it? Whatever game I imagine takes shape immediately. Please—sit."

\"E_90001_Clip12_105\".m_mContent: "So that's your goal... to defeat me and claim the title of Mastermind."

\"E_90001_Clip12_106\".m_mContent: "It may have devoured world after world to reach this one."

\"E_90001_Clip12_107\".m_mContent: "The Mastermind holds boundless knowledge. Endless, magnificent understanding."

\"E_90001_Clip12_109\".m_mContent: "Maybe you haven't considered this: I have no desire to become the Mastermind. There's no reason for us to fight."

\"E_90001_Clip12_110\".m_mContent: "Drop the act. From the moment I first saw you, I recognized the scent—you carry the same hunger."

\"E_90001_Clip12_111\".m_mContent: "That craving for truth... the most human of instincts."

\"E_90001_Clip12_112\".m_mContent: "Come, then. You'll take black. Make your move."

\"E_90001_Clip12_113\".m_mContent: "Its bloodlust... vanished. Is something stronger holding it back?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_118\".m_mContent: "No... Maybe it was losing that brought me back."

\"E_90001_Clip12_120\".m_mContent: "I don't think it's our enemy. Not right now."

\"E_90001_Clip12_122\".m_mContent: "It's vanishing...? Is that really... the end?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_126\".m_mContent: "We're all in one piece. This is a miracle..."

\"E_90001_Clip12_127\".m_mContent: "What about Stella and Noah? They should be back too, shouldn't they?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_128\".m_mContent: "Those two headed toward the bell tower—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_133\".m_mContent: "I know this sounds strange... but the flames from those exploding constructs... they remind me of the fireworks that lit up the sky over Asta, nineteen years ago."

\"E_90001_Clip12_134\".m_mContent: "If I hadn't been the one to light that bonfire... Would any of this have happened?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_135\".m_mContent: "History is inevitability, stitched from countless chance events. Even without you, fate may have found a second Stella. Or a third."

\"E_90001_Clip12_136\".m_mContent: "Had you not come today... I might have become the next anchor to open that door."

\"E_90001_Clip12_137\".m_mContent: "I've been thinking too... If only another 'Noah' had warned us, nineteen years ago. But thoughts like that—what good are they now?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_138\".m_mContent: "Even so, new seeds have taken root here. That's what matters."

\"E_90001_Clip12_141\".m_mContent: "Just as you said, tend these new seeds. Help them grow. Maybe that's what I was meant to do."

\"E_90001_Clip12_143\".m_mContent: "Come, time for our own Harvest Festival—"

\"E_90001_Clip12_146\".m_mContent: "Where else would I be but waiting for you?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_148\".m_mContent: "Well... truth is, I never really belonged to that world either. One day I just woke up there."

\"E_90001_Clip12_149\".m_mContent: "Besides, we make a great team, don't we? How about it? We stick together. Keep adventuring."

\"E_90001_Clip12_152\".m_mContent: "Ah, how could I forget about these two?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_153\".m_mContent: "Perfect timing. Once the El Dorado is patched up, we're setting sail again. Care to join us?"

\"E_90001_Clip12_155\".m_mContent: "Let's get one thing straight! This ship doesn't take freeloaders!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_156\".m_mContent: "And once you're aboard, you're 'family'. Which means no backstabbing, no drama, and no hurting each other."

\"E_90001_Clip12_159\".m_mContent: "You seem rather chummy with that grand alchemist, but I won't tolerate any experiments on my ship!"

\"E_90001_Clip12_160\".m_mContent: "Don't mind William—he always talks like that. But deep down, he's thrilled. Isn't that right?"
